dev_page_description: Services Hypha calls, signed with each app's secret: webhooks for the events they subscribe to, and live shipping rates.
dev_card_description: Your ERP, a fulfilment service, or your own code: anything that verifies the {header} header.
dev_rotate_warning: The current secret stops working at once.
dev_new_secret_tooltip: New secret: the current one stops working at once.
dev_timeout_invalid: Enter the timeout in milliseconds, like {example}.
dev_dialog_edit_subtitle: Changes apply to the next events; ones already on their way keep going.
dev_dialog_add_subtitle: Hypha signs every call to it with a secret it shows you next.
dev_key_description: {prefix} and lowercase letters, digits and _. Can't change later.
dev_webhook_url_description: Where Hypha POSTs events: https://, or http://localhost while developing. Leave empty for none.
dev_events_description: Event types, separated by commas: {one}, a whole kind like {kind}, or {all} for all.
dev_timeout_description: {min} to {max}. Slower answers count as failures and are retried.
dev_secret_subtitle: Copy it now: it isn't shown again. The app checks the {header} header with it.
state_not_built_in_description: Taken out of this API's build: its settings and data stay, and it does nothing until a build has it again.
state_built_in_on_description: Built into this store's API by its operator.
state_built_in_off_description: Built in, and turned off: it collects nothing and adds nothing.
state_uninstalled_description: Its access ended; it only got the {event} event.
state_off_description: It gets no webhooks and quotes no rates.
state_private_description: A private app: its manifest was uploaded to this store.
state_custom_description: Made by hand under Settings → Developers.
list_description: Services connected to your store: what each may do, and what it was sent.
list_no_access_description: Your role doesn't include {scope}. Ask the store owner for access.
list_empty_description: Install an app from its address, where you approve what it may do. To connect your own code, create a private app.
list_scopes_built_in: {count, plural, one {# scope, built in} other {# scopes, built in}}
install_dialog_subtitle: The app's own site starts the installation; you approve what it may do here.
install_address_description: Its site ({site}) or its manifest's URL ({manifest}).
install_address_invalid_description: Use an https:// URL (http:// only for localhost).
install_continue_hint: You'll continue on {host}, which sends you back here to approve. This store's API is {api}.
private_dialog_subtitle: Your own integration: its manifest says what it may do, you approve it, and its credentials are shown once.
private_paste_description: {file}: like a public app's, except it needs no {field}.
private_not_object: A manifest is a JSON object.
payment_action_done: Done: the payment is {status, select, pending {pending} authorized {authorized} processing {processing} paid {paid} failed {failed} voided {voided} partially_refunded {partially refunded} refunded {refunded} other {{status}}}.
payment_action_sent: Sent to the payment's app. The payment changes when it reports back.
detail_settings_description: What this store sets for it. Secret fields are kept sealed and never shown again.
detail_access_built_in: What it acts with, as declared in the build. Turn it off to stop it; its access can't be narrowed.
detail_access_granted: What the app's tokens may do, at most: approved by staff when it was installed.
detail_access_none: This app has no OAuth grant: it can't call the API, only receive webhooks.
detail_approved_by: Approved by {actor, select, user {a staff member} agent {an agent} api_key {an API key} app {the app itself} system {Hypha} other {someone}}, {time}.
detail_custom_hint: Custom apps are set up under Settings → Developers → Webhooks and custom apps.
detail_personal_built_in: A built-in app runs inside the API and reads what it needs there, personal data included: these are the kinds it declares it uses.
detail_personal_granted: Without these scopes Hypha leaves names, emails, phone numbers and addresses out of everything the app reads or receives.
detail_personal_none_built_in: It declares no use of personal data.
detail_personal_none: This app sees no personal data.
detail_history_description: Each time the app asked for access.
detail_history_by: by {actor, select, user {a staff member} agent {an agent} api_key {an API key} app {the app itself} system {Hypha} other {someone}}
reduce_dialog_subtitle: Untick what the app should no longer do. It loses those scopes at once and is told its grant changed.
reduce_hint: To give a scope back, the app asks again and staff approve it.
reduce_remove: {count, plural, =0 {Remove scopes} one {Remove # scope} other {Remove # scopes}}
actions_uninstall_description: Its access ends at once: its tokens stop working and it gets no more events except {event}. It can be installed again later.
actions_remove_description: The app, its signing secret and its delivery history are deleted. This can't be undone.
spore_secret_set: Set. Type a new value to replace it.
deliveries_description: Events go to {url}. Failed ones are retried for about 3 days.
deliveries_no_webhook: This app has no webhook, so it gets no events.
deliveries_empty_description: Each event the app subscribes to shows up here, kept for 30 days.
frame_invalid_address: This app page's address isn't valid
consent_no_request_description: The link may be old or mistyped. Start the installation again from the app, or upload a private app's manifest under Apps.
consent_cannot_answer_description: Your role doesn't include {scope}, so you can't see what the app asks for. Ask the store owner to approve it.
consent_blocked_no_write: Your role doesn't include {scope}: only staff who manage apps can approve one.
consent_blocked_missing_scopes: You can only grant what your own role has, and it lacks {scopes}. Ask someone whose role has them.
consent_expired_description: Requests wait ten minutes for an answer. Start the installation again from the app.
consent_may_do_nothing: Nothing beyond receiving the events it subscribes to.
consent_personal_none: None: Hypha leaves names, emails, phone numbers and addresses out of everything this app reads or receives.
consent_personal_intro: The app will see these fields of your customers. It gives these reasons:
consent_privacy_hint: What the app receives is its own to keep: read its <link>privacy policy</link>.
consent_intro_private: Approving installs the app and shows its credentials once. The request waits until {time}.
consent_intro_redirect: Approving sends you back to {host}. The request waits until {time}.
consent_intro_redirect_app: Approving sends you back to the app. The request waits until {time}.
consent_fields_added_to: The app adds fields to {owners}, in its own namespace ({namespace}).
consent_fields_retyped_description: It changes the type of {fields}; a field's type can't change.
consent_fields_removes_description: Approving deletes these fields and every value stored in them.
consent_changes_description: The app keeps its current access until you approve; denying leaves it as it is.
credentials_copy_now: Copy its credentials now: they aren't shown again.
credentials_help_new_secret: The access token works for an hour. Before it lapses, exchange the refresh token at {endpoint} ({grant}) for a new pair; each refresh token is used once and lasts 30 days. The app secret verifies Hypha's webhook and extension-point signatures.
credentials_help_kept_secret: The access token works for an hour. Before it lapses, exchange the refresh token at {endpoint} ({grant}) for a new pair; each refresh token is used once and lasts 30 days. The app keeps the secret it had.
credentials_keep_secret_description: They act as the app with the scopes you approved: store them in your server's secrets, never in a browser.
